allow: Shell(which omp pi 2>&1; echo "---"; ls -la ~/.omp/agent/ 2>&1 | head -20; echo "--- PI ---"; ls -la ~/.pi/agent/ 2>&1 | head -20; echo "--- VERSIONS ---"; omp --version 2>&1 | head -3; pi --version 2>&1 | head -3)

Shell(echo "===== PI HELP: session/rpc flags ====="; pi --help 2>&1 | grep -iE "session|mode|thinking|append|tools|provider|model|resume" ; echo; echo "===== OMP: does --session exist? ====="; omp --mode rpc --session /tmp/nope-xyz.jsonl --no-session </dev/null 2>&1 | head -20; echo "exit=$?"; echo; echo "===== OMP: unknown flag probe ====="; omp --definitely-not-a-flag 2>&1 | head -5)

Shell(cd /tmp && rm -f dray-probe.jsonl; echo "=== A) --session accepted? ==="; printf '%s\n' '{"id":"d1","type":"get_state"}' > /tmp/req.txt; (cat /tmp/req.txt; sleep 8) | timeout 25 omp --mode rpc --session /tmp/dray-probe.jsonl 2>&1 | head -c 1500; echo; echo "--- file created? ---"; ls -la /tmp/dray-probe.jsonl 2>&1; echo; echo "=== B) --no-session, full handshake ==="; (cat /tmp/req.txt; sleep 8) | timeout 25 omp --mode rpc --no-session 2>/dev/null | grep -E '"(ready|response)"' | head -c 3000)
